primary_work.title: Nonparametric Identification of Latent Concepts
primary_work.official_code: not located from primary records, author/lab publication pages, and targeted repository search

decision: NARROWED BEYOND SUPPLIED-CLASS NONPARAMETRIC CONCEPT IDENTIFICATION — NOT ADOPTED
rejected_claims: latent concepts discovered by comparing supplied observation or utterance classes are themselves a new raw-language contribution
identifying class-concept incidence from observed class diversity identifies the raw-utterance equivalence relation
human-readable class labels provide an anti-recoding denotation anchor
class-conditioned concept recovery or compositional extrapolation identifies an unknown intervention-target partition
remaining_rq: After applying the strongest non-language CRL and supplied-class nonparametric concept-identification results, can a preregistered externally fixed language law identify raw-utterance equivalence itself and strictly refine a residual intervention-target partition without supplied or retrospectively inferred class membership, outcome-derived grouping, or a jointly recodable denotation map?
